description: Renders each page of a PDF as an image at 150 DPI. The result is one ZIP archive with an image per page. Up to 100 pages. The file is uploaded to conv2pdf and the call counts as one conversion.

format.description: Format of the images. Default: png.

input_path.description: Path of the file on this computer: absolute, or relative to the working directory of the server.

output_path.description: Where to write the result. Optional: by default next to the input file, under a name that is not taken. An existing file is never overwritten.

password.description: Password of the PDF, only if it asks for one to open. The result has no password.

name: convert_pdf_to_images
title: Convert PDF to Images
